# The scoreboard

Measured 2026-08-15 by running `dist/gbselftest.gb` on each of these and
reading the report off the link port. Reproduce it with `tools/scoreboard.sh`;
every runner fetches and pins its own emulator, and none of them is vendored here.

<!-- table -->
| implementation | result |
|---|---:|
| SameBoy, DMG | 87 / 87 |
| SameBoy, MGB (Pocket) | 87 / 87 |
| SameBoy, CGB-E | 84 / 87, 3 skipped |
| SameBoy, AGB | 84 / 87, 3 skipped |
| TerminalGB, per-dot renderer | 86 / 87 |
| TerminalGB, whole-scanline renderer | 80 / 87 |
| Peanut-GB | 64 / 87 |
<!-- /table -->

Revisions measured: SameBoy `213a12c`, TerminalGB
`2467c65`, Peanut-GB
`8e65698`; the cartridge built with the RGBDS pinned in
`tools/fetch-rgbds.sh`.

A skip is not a pass, and it is not a failure either. On a Color console three
checks step aside: one defect that exists only in the original silicon, one rule
the cartridge has no second, independent way to measure there, and one handover
state no published table covers for a monochrome cartridge in compatibility
mode. Each of them prints its own reason in the run.
